title: skills(automation): the function-name paragraph of objectstack-automation SKILL.md is stale once function names are namespace-scoped (ADR-0150, #31700)
body:
epic:#31527#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYGYEUhpi29FpjLmxT

Part of #31527. Follow-up owed by PR #32513 (card #31700) under its `Skills-docs:` line (contract review 6812847136, epic ruling 6812862622 R2-D).

**What is stale.** `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` around line 261 (the paragraph on how a flow's function name resolves) says two packages shipping one function name make "the boot warn `Bare-name conflict at boot`". After #31700 lands, `function` is in `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES`, so two namespaces may each hold the name, and the PR's own `Skills-docs:` text names this line as no longer true.

**Fix.** Rewrite that sentence (and any eval that asserts it) to the behaviour #32513 ships, read from its FROM → TO table at merge: what the boot says, what a flow's bare reference resolves to, and what a two-holder bare engine read answers (ruling R2-C).

Premise re-check: `grep -n "Bare-name conflict at boot" skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` on `main` after #32513 merges; zero hits = premise gone, close.

Blocked-by: #31700
